reason: Cross-sectional analysis directly measures five DNAm-based epigenetic aging clocks (Horvath, Hannum, PhenoAge, GrimAge, DunedinPACE) and links them to diet quality, a modifiable exposure.
Study measures placental gene expression by RNA sequencing, not DNA methylation, histone modification, or chromatin state, despite discussing a histone methyltransferase gene.
Frailty-microvascular disease cohort analysis measures clinical frailty phenotype and retinal capillary density; no epigenetic marker is measured at all.
Longitudinal physical-activity intervention study directly measures promoter-specific DNA methylation of SOD2 and L3MBTL1 in breast cancer patients, linking it to a modifiable exercise intervention.
Abstract references 8 combined 'biological ages' from the SATSA twin study without stating whether any of them is a DNA-methylation-based epigenetic clock.
DNA-methylation-defined molecular classes of 139 human spinal ependymomas serve as the reference standard for a histology-based diagnostic classifier, a diagnostic comparison series.
Pyrosequencing directly measures MGMT promoter methylation at multiple cut-offs in a retrospective cohort of 78 glioblastoma patients, linked to treatment response and survival.
Tumor-derived DNA from a cohort study is screened for MLH1 promoter methylation/CIMP status, which is associated with MMR-deficiency subtyping relevant to Lynch-syndrome diagnosis.
A targeted plasma cfDNA methylation assay is directly measured and validated across independent clinical cohorts for noninvasive detection/monitoring of neuroendocrine prostate cancer.
Phase 1 KRAS-vaccine trial reports T-cell responses and ctDNA/tumor-antigen biomarkers; no epigenetic marker is measured.
Pediatric stroke transport-protocol study reports Glasgow Coma Scale and LVO clinical scores only; no epigenetic marker is measured.
BPDCN diagnostic series reports frequencies of genomic mutation subtypes, including genes in the DNA-methylation pathway, but does not directly measure methylation itself.
An epigenome-wide association study directly measures blood DNA methylation in a case-control design relating a history of perinatal asphyxia to schizophrenia/bipolar disorder risk.
Cross-sectional NSCH analysis of childhood obesity and social determinants of health measures no epigenetic marker.
Retrospective cohort of CRC patients directly measures MLH1 promoter methylation via reflex testing to guide genetic-counseling referral decisions for Lynch syndrome.
Cohort study directly measures LINE-1 global DNA methylation and MGMT promoter methylation in IDH-mutant astrocytoma tissue, linked to grade and prognosis.
Whole-exome sequencing and microarray study of germline cancer-predisposition variants measures genetic mutations, not a directly measured epigenetic marker.
Methylation-specific PCR directly measures Septin9 promoter methylation in breast tumor tissue from a retrospective series, linked to recurrence/metastasis prognosis.
DNA methylation array profiling of 42 pediatric MPNST/MPNST-like tumors is directly measured and used to reach an integrated diagnostic classification.
Bisulfite pyrosequencing directly measures cord-blood methylation of serotonin-regulating genes (SLC6A4, MAOA, HTR2A), linked to modifiable maternal metabolic exposures (pBMI, GWG, GDM).

Citrullinated histone is assessed by immunohistochemistry in plaque tissue as a NET/inflammation marker, matching the instrument's explicit protein-assay exclusion for citrullinated H3 rather than a chromatin-state measurement.
Nested case-control study directly measures a 13-gene DNA methylation panel from oral brushings used for periodic surveillance monitoring after oral cancer surgery.
MGMT-unmethylated status is only a fixed cohort inclusion criterion here; the predictor actually analyzed against survival is cognitive test performance, not the methylation marker.
Genome-wide DNA methylation array data directly measured in 385 IDH-mutant astrocytomas is used for a methylation-based prognostic subclassification.
Quantitative methylation-specific PCR directly measures ASCL1/ZNF582 methylation in a cross-sectional series of anal biopsies to determine diagnostic performance for HGAIN and anal cancer.
Longitudinal cohort directly measures blood DNAm aging from adolescence to adulthood, linked to childhood mental-health symptoms and substance-use exposures.
Randomized physiotherapy trial on premature aging measures relative telomere size and metabolic/inflammatory markers, not DNA methylation, histone modification, or chromatin state.

A multi-cohort GWAS meta-analysis draws CpG methylation (ASM-QTL) associations from summary statistics rather than analyzing individual-level methylation data, the instrument's clearest not_primary example.
Women's Health Initiative cohort directly measures whole-blood 450K DNAm-based epigenetic aging (GrimAge, DNAmTL) linked to stressful-life-event exposure burden.
ARID1A loss is assessed via mutation, copy-number deletion, and immunohistochemical protein expression, not by a directly measured DNA methylation, histone modification, or chromatin-state mark.
A tumor methylation score from methylated ctDNA is directly and repeatedly measured in HCC patients over time to monitor treatment burden and detect recurrence.
Case-control and prospective follow-up study directly measures BNIP3/DAPK1 promoter methylation in peripheral leukocytes for gastric-cancer detection, chemotherapy response and prognosis.
Randomized dietary-intervention trial (Obekit) directly measures EPIC-array DNA methylation at baseline to predict percentage weight loss on two hypocaloric diets.
Epigenome-wide association study directly measures DNA methylation differences between T2DM cases and normoglycemic controls in the KoGES cohort, identifying candidate diabetes biomarkers.
Case-control study directly measures Alu DNA methylation patterns (COBRA) in peripheral blood of type 1 diabetes patients versus healthy controls.
Strong Heart Study cohort directly measures DNAm-based epigenetic aging (PhenoAge, GrimAge, DunedinPACE) mediating the association of arsenic exposure with CVD and mortality risk.
Retrospective periacetabular osteotomy outcomes study measures patient-reported joint function and satisfaction scores; no epigenetic marker is measured.
Nested case-control study within a randomized trial directly measures HPV genome methylation (S5 classifier) jointly with serum folate to stratify CIN3+ risk.
Case-control study directly measures RUNX1 promoter methylation to differentiate papillary thyroid cancer from benign thyroid nodules, an explicit diagnostic application.
TCGA and GEO methylome data are directly analyzed in HNSCC/OSCC patients to build a 16-CpG senescence-related prognostic signature to guide treatment strategy.
Genomic DNAm episignature is directly measured in 18 individuals with USP7 variants and used as a diagnostic biomarker to reclassify variants of uncertain significance.
Study cohort consists of client-owned dogs with multicentric high-grade B-cell lymphoma, not human participants.
National Cancer Database cohort directly reports MGMT promoter methylation status, linked to overall survival and treatment stratification in IDH-wildtype/mutant gliomas.
Exome-sequencing study of de novo variants underlying syndromic intellectual disability measures genetic mutations, not a directly measured epigenetic marker.

Core findings derive from a mouse model of radiation-induced thrombocytopenia; the human megakaryocyte cell line is only used for supplementary in vitro mechanistic confirmation, not an epidemiological design on the eligible list.

Case-control study of acute kidney injury measures methylation-related metabolites (choline, SAM, SAH, betaine, TMAO) in plasma/urine, not DNA methylation, histone modification, or chromatin state itself.
Birth-cohort study directly measures sperm DNA methylation (reduced representation bisulfite sequencing) linking paternal air-pollution exposure to offspring birth outcomes.
This is an explicit study protocol for a planned two-armed RCT of yoga on biological age; no primary data are yet reported.
Randomized folic-acid supplementation trial directly measures 450K DNA methylation array data and epigenetic clocks (AgeAccel) in healthy male volunteers.

Targeted bisulfite sequencing directly measures cord-blood methylation differences between LGA and AGA newborns, but the study only describes these biological differences without linking the marker to a modifiable exposure, intervention, or a stated clinical/public-health decision.

This is a small case series of two families (plus a literature-pooled proband review) with HPS6 variants; the CpG-island overlap with variants is a structural bioinformatic observation, not a design-based methylation measurement.

Longitudinal epigenome-wide association study directly measures blood DNAm changes at HDAC4/MARK3 associated with treatment response after medication-withdrawal treatment in chronic migraine patients.
The circ-YAP/m6A mechanism for CRC liver metastasis is established through in vitro assays and a PDX/xenograft animal model, not through one of the five eligible human epidemiological designs.
Prospective screening cohort of 3000 participants directly measures blood Septin9/SRSF1/PAX8 gene methylation for early colorectal cancer screening.
Study measures SUV420H1 protein expression by immunohistochemistry as a prognostic factor in HCC, not the H4K20 histone methylation mark that the enzyme deposits.
KDMAge and PhenoAge here are explicitly calculated from clinical chemistry biomarkers, not from DNA methylation.

Prospective genomic profiling of 459 IDH-wildtype glioblastomas directly measures DNA methylation, classifying a distinct replication-repair-deficient subtype relevant to immune checkpoint blockade treatment.
TCGA cohort correlates DNA methylation with genetic ancestry to build a machine-learning ancestry classifier, without linking the marker to a modifiable exposure or a stated clinical decision.

Multi-database cohort analysis attributes KLF3 silencing to CpG-island methylation and links this epigenetic mechanism to prognosis and therapeutic drug sensitivity in clear cell renal cell carcinoma.
TCGA-based analysis includes direct DNA methylation profiling of SLC7A11 (MethSurv) associated with breast-cancer subtype and patient outcome, alongside expression/copy-number data.
Two-sample and summary-data-based Mendelian randomization draws methylation-BMD associations from GWAS summary statistics, the instrument's clearest not_primary example.
Case-control study directly measures human sperm DNA methylation array data comparing COVID-19-infected and healthy semen donors.
Case-control study directly measures PRLHR promoter methylation in hippocampal tissue and plasma cfDNA of Alzheimer's patients as a candidate liquid-biopsy diagnostic biomarker.
A hierarchical classifier is developed and validated using individual-level methylation array data from thousands of human tumor samples across 30 cancer types, a diagnostic-accuracy application.
DNA methylation profiling is directly measured and clustered in a cohort of human diffuse midline glioma tumors, defining a new diagnostic/prognostic subtype relevant to trial interpretation.
Case-control study directly measures CD70 gene methylation in T-cell DNA comparing systemic lupus erythematosus patients and population controls.
Nested case-control study directly measures a methylation risk score from four CpG loci associated with incident type 2 diabetes risk.
Framingham Heart Study cohort directly measures DNA methylation, among other omics layers, associated with coronary artery calcification and myocardial infarction risk.
Case-control study directly measures urinary cell-free DNA methylation markers developed and validated for hepatocellular carcinoma screening.
UK Biobank phenotypic-age study computes biological age from nine clinical chemistry biomarkers, not DNA methylation.
Spatial transcriptomic profiling of tumor-associated endothelial cells in TNBC measures gene expression, not a directly measured epigenetic marker.
Radiogenomic study directly incorporates DNA-methylation-seq data from glioblastoma patients into a prognostic overall-survival risk-stratification nomogram.

RNA-seq/ATAC-seq discovery in a handful of iCCA tumors identifies a PLK1/MISP mechanism, but the marker linked to clinicopathological outcome in the larger 91-patient cohort is protein expression, not a directly measured chromatin-state variable.

This study compares 16 normalisation methods for a BMI EpiScore and Horvath's clock across two birth cohorts, a purely technical/methodological analysis without linking methylation to a modifiable exposure or explicit clinical decision.
Cross-sectional whole-blood DNA methylation comparison directly measures epigenetic age acceleration in the Yakutian population versus Central Russia, related to subarctic climate adaptation.

Analysis of offspring from an RCT directly measures genome-wide DNA methylation in placenta, cord blood, and buccal cells comparing CAPA-IVM versus conventional IVF, a modifiable fertility-treatment choice.
Nested case-control study directly measures AHRR/F2RL3 blood methylation linked to modifiable smoking and occupational exposures.
This is an explicit prospective study protocol (MeD-Seq Rectal) describing planned DNA-methylation liquid-biopsy work to predict chemoradiation response; no primary data are yet reported.
KDM-BA and physiological dysregulation aging measures are derived from clinical biomarkers in this napping/cognition study, not DNA methylation.
PRISM cohort directly measures placental DNA methylation array data to infer cell-type composition associated with gestational ambient PM2.5 air-pollution exposure.
Case-control study directly measures HYAL1 promoter methylation in FFPE thyroid tissue to differentiate malignant papillary thyroid cancer from benign nodules.
Prospective cohort directly measures principal-component-based DNAm epigenetic-age clocks in spinal-deformity surgery patients for preoperative frailty/surgical risk assessment.
Case-control study directly measures placental/plasma DNA methylation and nucleosome positioning patterns to build and validate a diagnostic model for early-onset preeclampsia.
Phase Ib trial of HDAC-inhibitor entinostat plus pembrolizumab reports clinical response and immune-cell (MDSC) outcomes without directly measuring histone acetylation or another epigenetic mark.
Sperm chromatin dispersion test measures DNA fragmentation and oxidative stress, which the instrument explicitly treats as strand-breakage/packaging, not a regulatory epigenetic mark.
This is a single-patient case report of pseudohypoparathyroidism type Ib, even though GNAS methylation was measured diagnostically in that one patient.
ALSPAC cohort directly measures cord-blood DNA methylation patterns co-varying with maternal risk profiles, prospectively linked to childhood cardiometabolic/neurocognitive risk.
This is a single-patient case report of long-term decitabine/ATRA maintenance therapy in an elderly AML patient.
TCGA-UCEC cohort directly analyzes individual-level DNA methylation data at specific CpG sites to build a prognostic risk model for endometrial cancer.
Strong Heart Study prospective cohort directly measures blood DNA methylation (850K array) associated with liver-cancer mortality risk in American Indians.
Case-control study directly measures RB1 promoter methylation by real-time PCR in retinoblastoma patients versus healthy controls to test a hereditary-transmission risk mechanism.
Prospective cohort directly measures blood DNA methylation (Illumina BeadChip) comparing current, former, and never smokers with Crohn's disease or ulcerative colitis.
Retrospective/prospective case series directly measures H3K27me3 histone-mark loss by immunohistochemistry in sarcomatoid carcinomas as a differential-diagnosis pitfall for MPNST.
Cross-sectional comparative study directly measures differential DNA methylation in peripheral immune cells across ACPA-positive at-risk, ACPA-negative, and early rheumatoid arthritis groups.
NHANES cross-sectional study computes biological aging (homeostatic dysregulation, KDM, phenotypic age, allostatic load) from clinical biomarkers, not DNA methylation.
Two independent birth cohorts directly measure neonatal DNA methylation (EPIC array) associated with maternal PCOS/hirsutism and preconception testosterone exposure.
Case-control study directly measures blood CD4+ T-cell DNA methylation (RRBS) with ROC-based diagnostic performance reported for atrial fibrillation.
Case-control study directly measures cfDNA 5-hydroxymethylcytosine, a DNA modification mark, in a machine-learning diagnostic model for early lung-cancer detection.
Cross-sectional St Jude Lifetime Cohort study directly measures DNAm-based epigenetic age acceleration associated with deficit accumulation in childhood-cancer survivors.
PhenoAge here is explicitly derived from clinical traits rather than DNA methylation, so no epigenetic marker is measured in this sleep/aging Mendelian randomization study.
